capabilities: push-notifications | Receives messages over a REST API and pushes them in real time to the web interface and to client apps subscribed to the server.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official Gotify server image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Gotify is a self-hosted notification server: create an application to get a token, send messages to it with a plain HTTP request, and read them live in the web interface or in the Gotify apps. It has users, applications and clients, message priorities, and a WebSocket stream. Everything is kept in the instance's own SQLite database, stored in the `gotify` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated administrator password. Sign in at `https://<instance>/` with the administrator name and password, create an application, and send a message with its token. Public self-registration is switched off. You can run one Gotify instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Gotify documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

features: Messages with titles, priorities and markdown, sent over a REST API
Applications with their own tokens, and clients that read the stream
Live web interface and a WebSocket stream
Apps for Android and a command-line client
Your data is kept in your home, across stops, restarts and re-enrollment

GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_NAME.description: The administrator's user name, created on the first start. It is used only when Gotify first creates its database: your data lives in your home, so if the database already exists (an earlier enrollment, or a later restart) this value is ignored and the existing users still apply.
GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_NAME.title: Administrator name

GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. It is the administrator's password only when Gotify first creates its database; if the database already exists this value is ignored and the existing password still applies. Change the password in Gotify's own settings. Save it; it is also shown in the enrollment's instance details.
GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS.title: Administrator password
